benchmarks.name: BenchmarkBuildPackageMainApplication
benchmarks.rationale: Bounds immutable application-model construction while allowing for supported shared CI hosts.

benchmarks.name: BenchmarkRenderPackageMainApplication
benchmarks.rationale: Bounds deterministic generated-Go rendering, including source-mapped debug units and production feature renderers.

benchmarks.name: BenchmarkServiceCachedOverlayAnalysis
benchmarks.rationale: Bounds the repeated editor-analysis path after an identical overlay snapshot is warm; the ceiling includes the measured 381 allocs/op median on a clean Go 1.26.5 Windows hosted runner while retaining bounded headroom.

benchmarks.name: BenchmarkParseRunArguments
benchmarks.rationale: Bounds process-boundary argument parsing independently of compilation and application startup.

benchmarks.name: BenchmarkStructuralFingerprint
benchmarks.rationale: Bounds body-insensitive source classification used to bypass analysis and generation during spice dev.
